list.invitations: {count, plural, one {# invitation waiting} other {# invitations waiting}}

create.title: New group
create.name: Name of the group
create.noResults: Nobody was found. Only members you could write to privately can be invited.
create.none: Nobody yet. You can also invite people later.
create.note: Each person gets an invitation and joins only if they accept it. Up to 50 people in a group.

group.left: You are no longer in this group.

cannot.membersOnly: Your account isn’t verified as a physician’s yet, so you can read this group but not write in it.
cannot.suspended: The staff suspended you from sending messages. You can still read.

details.title: About this group
details.makeAdminText: They will be able to rename the group, invite and remove people. You stay in the group as one of its people.
details.removeText: They leave the group now. What they wrote stays. They can be invited again.
details.leaveText: What you wrote stays in the group. To come back you need a new invitation.
details.leaveAdminText: What you wrote stays in the group. The person who has been in it longest will run it. To come back you need a new invitation.
details.pin: Pin to the top of my list
details.unpin: Take down from the top of my list
details.staffNote: The staff can’t read a group. They see only a message that someone reports, with the five before and after it.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.intro: Groups and rooms you were invited to. You are in none of them, and read nothing of them, until you accept.
invitations.groupNote: If you accept, the people in the group see your first and last name and what you write there.
invitations.roomNote: If you accept, the people in the room see your first and last name, also if you are not listed in the member directory.
invitations.declineNote: Whoever invited you is not told that you declined.

files.hint: Pictures (JPEG, PNG) and PDF up to 10 MB, one MP4 video up to 100 MB. Up to three files.
files.patientNote: Do not send pictures, documents or videos of patients.
files.videoNote: A video is sent exactly as it is, with what your phone wrote into it, such as when and where it was filmed.
files.tooMany: A message carries up to three files, and one video at most.
files.typeNotAllowed: This type of file can’t be sent. Use a JPEG or PNG picture, a PDF, or an MP4 video.
files.unavailable: This file is no longer available.

forward.title: Forward this message
forward.intro: A copy of its text and its files is sent. The copy is marked “Forwarded” and doesn’t say who wrote it or where it came from.
forward.empty: You have nowhere to forward it to yet.

settings.invitesFrom: Who can invite me to groups and to rooms by invitation
settings.invitesListed: Members who could write to me privately
settings.invitesContacts: Only people I already have a conversation or a group with
settings.invitesNote: An invitation never puts you in a group or a room. You join only if you accept it.
settings.showActivity: Show the people I talk with when I am active
settings.showActivityHint: They see a dot while you have chat open, and otherwise “active today”, “this week” or “a while ago”, never a time. If you switch this off, you won’t see it for them either. It is never shown in rooms or in the member directory.

room.inviteNote: This room is by invitation: it is not in “Browse rooms”, and a member joins only by accepting an invitation.

admin.inviteOnly: By invitation only: not listed in “Browse rooms”; moderators and staff invite members
